name: High School Retention Warning and Notice
description: Notification to families when a high school student is in danger of retention before year end, and written notice once retention is determined.
deadline: prior to the end of the school year
quote: If a student is in danger of being retained, a notification will be sent to the student's parents/guardians prior to the end of the school year. The high school staff will meet with the student to inform them of their status and monitor their progress. Once a determination has been made, the student and parents/guardians shall receive written notice of the student's retention.
